scope: Declared runtime exports, class members and constructors for all seven published entrypoints; structural export/member snapshot includes types. Inherited platform APIs and nested option/event/return-value semantics need separate review.
interpretation: Mapped-partial links a member to a reviewed behavior family and relevant test implementations. It does not assert that every member or behavior in that family is directly tested. Live evidence applies only to the listed assertions and sampled input hashes; it is not complete package or release qualification.

behaviorGroups.behavior: Construct owners, apply options and roll back partial acquisition
behaviorGroups.failures: invalid host/options, resource acquisition failure, reentry
behaviorGroups.backends: DOM owners, providers and backend-independent facades
gaps: Full constructor-option cross-product is not audited
Provider and error constructors need dedicated individual assertion review

behaviorGroups.behavior: Admit a source, retire old work, join cleanup, permit close/reopen
behaviorGroups.failures: abort, replacement, stale completion, cleanup failure
behaviorGroups.backends: Native, Hybrid, Software; streaming path separately
gaps: Network failures across Hybrid/Software remote opens, adaptive streams and custom sources beyond the bounded Native file cases
Close/reopen combined with authentication failure and cleanup errors

behaviorGroups.behavior: Preserve accepted intent and latest seek; validate and apply settings
behaviorGroups.states: idle, paused, playing, seeking, buffering, retired
behaviorGroups.failures: invalid arguments, supersession, reentry, operation failure
gaps: Every command pair under delayed network/output and replacement
Browser activation, backgrounding and device changes across all routes

behaviorGroups.behavior: Publish immutable current-source observations and retire subscriptions
behaviorGroups.failures: observer throws, reentry, stale backend events
behaviorGroups.backends: All routed backends; raw diagnostics differ
gaps: Event ordering and every state projection under live faults
Raw properties/audio diagnostics are not individually audited here

behaviorGroups.behavior: Admit compatible routes and preserve intent/settings across transitions
behaviorGroups.failures: unsupported capability, asset failure, source replacement
gaps: Live recovery for every filter/codec/provider combination
Concurrent route change with attachment, preview and network failures

behaviorGroups.behavior: Share/cancel preparation and report progress without reviving retired owners
behaviorGroups.failures: fetch failure, cancellation, concurrent consumers
gaps: Cross-browser cancellation during compile/instantiate
Cache corruption and deployment revision changes

behaviorGroups.behavior: Keep track intent and attachment identity scoped to the accepted source
behaviorGroups.failures: forged/stale handle, partial attachment, superseded selection
behaviorGroups.backends: Native text/ASS, Hybrid, Software, Shaka have different support
gaps: Live attach/remove/select races across every supported backend
Missing fonts, failed subtitle transfers and source replacement combinations

behaviorGroups.behavior: Validate timing/style settings and apply effective values on supported routes
behaviorGroups.failures: invalid values, backend rejection, retired setting
gaps: Actual subtitle/audio synchronization after overlapping timing changes
Explicit unsupported-route and style coverage per browser

behaviorGroups.behavior: Resolve requested buffering policy into route-specific effective state
behaviorGroups.failures: invalid policy, configure rejection, source retirement
gaps: Live transfer interruption during policy changes
Authentication refresh and memory pressure across streaming routes

behaviorGroups.behavior: Constrain quality by source/audio intent and restore failed configurations
behaviorGroups.failures: configure/select/verify failure, rollback failure, supersession
gaps: Cross-browser quality/audio races under segment failures
Live-edge movement and authorization refresh during rollback

behaviorGroups.behavior: Keep range/loop/chapter actions source-scoped and expose actual image output
behaviorGroups.failures: invalid range, stale chapter, unsupported frame step, snapshot retirement
gaps: Boundary combinations with reverse step, EOF, source replacement and resize
Live snapshot cancellation and pixel correctness on every supported route

behaviorGroups.behavior: Select an output device with capability and permission checks
behaviorGroups.failures: unsupported sink, permission rejection, device failure
gaps: Real device removal, permission revocation and repeated changes
Per-browser physical routing and audible output remain unverified

behaviorGroups.behavior: Expose source-scoped image requests and cache controls
behaviorGroups.states: idle, paused, playing, seeking, replacing, destroyed
behaviorGroups.failures: abort, stale completion, cache pressure, provider failure
gaps: Provider fallback during live network/decoder failures
All exact-time and cache-boundary combinations across browsers

behaviorGroups.behavior: Arbitrate callers, providers, generation and bounded cache ownership
behaviorGroups.failures: late provider, aborted caller, invalid output, resource acquisition failure
gaps: Every public mutator during an in-flight live request
Repeated provider replacement and failed cancellation

behaviorGroups.behavior: Produce validated preview images and release temporary resources
behaviorGroups.failures: bad media, cancellation, cleanup failures
gaps: Software cancellation at actual decoder output and worker failure
Authored callback reentry and mutable metadata in live hosts

behaviorGroups.behavior: Own fullscreen/PiP/media-session transitions without destroying borrowed playback
behaviorGroups.failures: permission rejection, unsupported API, late browser completion
gaps: Shipping Safari and OS media-session/device interactions
Fullscreen/PiP races with destruction and tab backgrounding

behaviorGroups.behavior: Inspect bounded custom/local sources without taking borrowed ownership
behaviorGroups.failures: short read, identity change, read failure, budget exceeded
gaps: Custom-source inspection races, cross-origin credentials and repeated authorization failures beyond the local HTTP cases

behaviorGroups.behavior: Forward commands and preserve owned/borrowed lifetimes
behaviorGroups.failures: observer throws, late failure, reentrant disposal
gaps: Host-framework remount and event races across all browsers

behaviorGroups.behavior: Project media semantics and detach borrowed bindings
behaviorGroups.failures: invalid ranges, stale event, ownership mismatch
gaps: Attribute/property/event ordering during live rebind and DOM adoption

behaviorGroups.behavior: Keep custom-element options, controls and player ownership coherent
behaviorGroups.failures: invalid attribute, late construction, acquisition failure
gaps: Per-member UI assertions are not individually mapped yet
Keyboard, accessibility, focus and touch combinations across browsers

behaviorGroups.behavior: Adapt borrowed/owned player lifetime to Video.js
behaviorGroups.failures: cross-document owner, registration/reentry failure
gaps: Version-specific Video.js live remount and source-error recovery

behaviorGroups.behavior: Select admitted provider recipes and bound asset acquisition
behaviorGroups.failures: missing asset, unsupported codec, stale owner, corrupt response
gaps: Complete recipe/codec/browser/deployment cross-product is not qualified
Cancellation and corrupt assets during execution in installed consumers

behaviorGroups.behavior: Expose stable constants and serializable public error data
behaviorGroups.failures: invalid/hostile error payload
gaps: Constant values and every error-code payload need a dedicated member-level assertion audit
